schema_note: Machine-readable companion to docs/research/requirements-audit/01-founder-requirements-audit.md. One entry per requirement checked against two Drive product documents (ORYN — Product & MVP Decision Register; ORYN Programlama). depth='full' items were agent- or multi-file-verified with cross-checked citations; depth='spot_check' items got one direct real-code check. Status values: implemented | partially_implemented | not_implemented | contradicted | stale_documentation | ambiguous_scope | not_code_verifiable. This is an audit artifact, not a RULE-COUNSEL rule — intentionally a separate namespace/id scheme (AUDIT-### rather than RULE-COUNSEL-###) since it characterizes implementation status, not counseling logic.
